verses.1: And now, as Jehovah has said, “Jacob, your tent shall be blessed; Israel, you shall be created.” Do not fear! For I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.
verses.2: For if you walk through the waters, I will be with you. And in the rivers, they will not wash you away. When you walk in fire, you will not be burned; and when you come into flames, they will not harm you.
verses.3: For I, Jehovah your God, am holy and righteous. I have delivered you from Egypt with great power and glory. You are my chosen people.
verses.4: For what you value in my eyes, I will protect it. I love you, and I will give people under your control, and nations under your rule.
verses.5: Do not be afraid, for I will bring your seed from the east. I will also bring you out from the waste land.
verses.6: I said to Tzafon, “Give me your children, and do not harm them. Bring my sons from afar, and my daughters from every corner of the earth.”
verses.7: All those who are called by my name and who honor me, I created them, I formed them, and I also made their deeds.
verses.8: He brings forth a people with eyes, ears, and noses.
verses.9: All the nations will be united together. They will be gathered into one people. Then those among them who can say this will be recognized as true. Their ancestors will speak for them, and they will be justified and listen to what they say. They will say the truth.
verses.10: You are witnesses that I am Jehovah’s servant. I have chosen you to be my witnesses, so that you may know and believe in me, and understand that I am the one who stands before you. There will be no other god besides Me. After Me, there will be no other gods.
verses.11: I am Jehovah; no one else can save me.
verses.12: I have declared it, and I have saved it; I have heard it, and there is no stranger among you. You are witnesses, O LORD! And I am He.
verses.13: From that day onward, I alone will do this; no one else can save me from this situation. No one can restore me to my former state.
verses.14: As Jehovah has said, “I will bless you, O holy Israel. I sent down Babel and its destruction. All its idols were destroyed by me.”
verses.15: I, Jehovah, am your God. I created Israel as your king.
verses.16: Thus said Jehovah, the Giver of life: “In the seas, there will be paths; and in the strong waters, there will be ways.”
verses.17: They create a bed of vines and wild plants. Together, they lie down on that bed; they do not move from there. They remain still, as if they were frozen in place.
verses.18: Do not forget our ancestors and those who came before us. Do not abandon them.
verses.19: I am making something new now. It will flourish when you know about it. Even if I place it on the shore, along the rivers.
verses.20: May the life in the wilderness please me. May the birds and animals respond to me, for I have been placed in the desert, with rivers flowing there, so that I can quench the thirst of my people with these waters.
verses.21: I have created a song for me; let them sing it.
verses.22: And you did not call me Jacob, because Israel suffered in me.
verses.23: You did not bring me your livestock and sacrifices. You did not serve me with offerings, nor did you touch me with kindness.
verses.24: I did not buy it with money. Your offerings of milk and wine I did not accept. Instead, I served you in your sins, and I endured your hardships.
verses.25: I, I alone, will bear witness to your sins and transgressions. Your sins and faults I will not forget.
verses.26: Let me be remembered. You were judged together with her. You did this in order to be punished.
verses.27: Your first father sinned, and your ancestors committed sins.
verses.28: And I will bless the priests of the Holy Temple, and I will give them Jacob and Israel as gifts.
